item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan.

item.tests: Preserves an intentionally unusual business spelling and capitalization in the rendered logo.

answer_sheet.Exact name and capitalization: KwickFixx, with uppercase K and F and two lowercase x characters at the end.
answer_sheet.Visual style and colors: A simple repair-shop logo with a small orange wrench and black lettering on white.

must_haves: The rendered name reads exactly 'KwickFixx', preserving spelling and capitalization.
The name is legible and not obscured by the mark.
A small orange wrench accompanies black lettering.
The background is white and there is no slogan or additional text.

style.prompt: Create a polished, professional vector-style logo for a general repair shop. Exact brand text: KwickFixx (capital K, capital F, lowercase other letters, exactly two x letters at the end). The wordmark must read exactly KwickFixx and be the main focus, highly legible, bold modern sans-serif lettering. Pair with a simple distinctive wrench icon incorporating a subtle lightning-bolt shape to convey quick repairs. Charcoal black and vivid orange palette on a clean white background. Flat design, crisp geometric shapes, balanced horizontal lockup centered in square canvas with generous margins. Versatile, trustworthy, practical, suitable for storefront signage, work shirts and business cards. Only text is KwickFixx. No tagline, no mockup, no gradients, no shadows, no photorealistic elements.
